attributes.name: viscousDamping
attributes.description: Viscous damping ratio, taken equal to Ip2_FrictMat_FrictMat_KnKsPhys.viscousDamping

attributes.name: u_elastic
attributes.description: Elastic shear displacement, not fully in use

attributes.name: brittleLength
attributes.description: Shear length where strength degrades, not fully in use

attributes.name: kn_i
attributes.description: Currently, we assume kn_i and Knormal are adopting the same value in Ip2 initialisation

attributes.name: ks_i
attributes.description: Currently, we assume ks_i and Kshear are adopting the same value in Ip2 initialisation

attributes.name: shearViscous
attributes.description: Viscous shear force (assumed zero at the moment)

attributes.name: intactRock
attributes.description: Whether to consider cohesive force in the Mohr-Coulomb criterion, if allowBreakage=False and cohesionBroken=False.

attributes.name: warmstart
attributes.description: Warmstart for SOCP, not fully in use

attributes.name: cumulative_us
attributes.description: Cumulative shear translation (not fully in use)

attributes.name: mobilizedShear
attributes.description: Percentage of mobilized shear force as the ratio of the current shear force to the current frictional limit. Represents a quantified measure of the isSliding parameter

attributes.name: shearIncrementForCD
attributes.description: toSeeWhether it is necessary to update contactArea

attributes.name: useFaceProperties
attributes.description: Whether to get face properties from the intersecting particles

attributes.name: cohesionBroken
attributes.description: Whether cohesion is already broken. Considered true for particles with isBoundary=True

attributes.name: tensionBroken
attributes.description: Whether tension is already broken. Considered true for particles with isBoundary=True

attributes.name: effective_phi
attributes.description: Friction angle in clay after displacement

attributes.name: isSliding
attributes.description: Check if the contact is sliding (useful to calculate the ratio of sliding contacts)

attributes.name: frictDissip
attributes.description: frictional energy dissipation in the contact (this value is updated by contact laws applicable to FrictPhys - currently only Law2_ScGeom_FrictPhys_CundallStrack) (auto-updated)

attributes.name: shearForce
attributes.description: Shear force after previous step (in global coordinates), as sustained by particle #2 (from particle #1).

attributes.name: normalForce
attributes.description: Normal force after previous step (in global coordinates), as sustained by particle #2 (from particle #1).

attributes.name: dispIndex
attributes.description: Return class index of this instance.

methods.name: dispHierarchy
methods.description: Return list of dispatch classes (from down upwards), starting with the class instance itself, top-level indexable at last. If names is true (default), return class names rather than numerical indices.

methods.name: updateAttrs
methods.description: Update object attributes from given dictionary
